course.title: Foundation Engineering
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: Design a combined footing for two columns $\mathtt { c } _ { 1 }$ and $\mathtt { C } _ { 2 }$ having a centre to centre distance of 18 ft. Column $\mathtt { C } _ { 1 }$ is 16 inch $\times 1 6$ inch in size and carries a load of 185 kips. Column ${ \sf C } _ { 2 }$ is 18 inch x 18 inch in size and carries a load of 215 kips. The safe bearing capacity of soil is 1.15 ksf. Use $f ^ { \prime } \circ = 3 5 0 0$ psi and $\mathfrak { f } _ { \mathfrak { s } } = 2 4 0 0 0$ psi. Show the reinforcement details.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
